_comment: Diablo III (PS4) trophy names and descriptions, by trophy id, for the on-screen notices and the launcher's Trophies page. Source: the PS4 trophy list (Exophase, CUSA00242), each entry matched to the TROPnnn.PNG icon of the same id in the 1.47 update's trophy00.trp. The game's own texts (TROPCONF.ESFM) are encrypted with Sony's trophy key.
title: Diablo III

groups.name: Diablo III: Rise of the Necromancer

trophies.name: Diablo III: Reaper of Souls Platinum Trophy
trophies.description: Collected all other Diablo III: Reaper of Souls trophies.

trophies.name: The Comfort of Strangers
trophies.description: Recruit the Templar, Scoundrel, and Enchantress.

trophies.name: Up All Night To Get Lucky
trophies.description: Equip all Inventory slots with Legendary items that have a minimum required level of 70 or higher.

trophies.name: Breaking Not So Bad
trophies.description: Use a merchant to repair an item.

trophies.name: Socket to Me
trophies.description: Socket a gem in an item.

trophies.name: Just Riffing
trophies.description: Kill 500 monsters while in Nephalem Rifts.

trophies.name: Dashing through the Rift
trophies.description: Finish a Nephalem Rift within 15 Minutes.

trophies.name: The Last of the Horadrim
trophies.description: Complete all quests in Act I.

trophies.name: The Black Soulstone
trophies.description: Complete all quests in Act II.

trophies.name: The Wages of Sin
trophies.description: Complete all quests in Act III.

trophies.name: Victory and Sacrifice
trophies.description: Complete all quests in Act IV.

trophies.name: Don't Fear the Reaper
trophies.description: Complete all quests in Act V.

trophies.name: The Elitist
trophies.description: Kill 500 elite (champion, rare, or unique) enemies.

trophies.name: Demolition Derby
trophies.description: Get a destruction callout for breaking 50 objects.

trophies.name: The Silence When You Speak to Me
trophies.description: Listen to all of Master Ordan's conversations in the Pandemonium Fortress.

trophies.name: Bringer of Order
trophies.description: Complete Act V with a Necromancer.

trophies.name: Bone Skewer
trophies.description: Damage 40 enemies with Bone Spear in 3 seconds.

trophies.name: What Is Dead Can Sometimes Die
Terror in the Blood
trophies.description: Defeat Diablo after using an ability that costs health while below 10% of your life.

trophies.name: Game of Bones
trophies.description: Use Bone Armor to rip the bones from the Skeleton King.

trophies.name: Skeleton Crew
trophies.description: Kill 500 elite (champion, rare, or unique) enemies with Command Skeleton minions.

trophies.name: Self Controlled
trophies.description: Kill your own Shadow Clone with Simulacrum during the Diablo encounter.
